digest.component_or_area: LLM provider resolution and OpenAI integration
propositions: Hosted OpenAI providers (bare openai:/inferred gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt with no custom endpoint) must default to openai-responses: qualifier instead of openai-chat:
OpenAI providers with custom base_url or per-candidate/per-slot endpoint overrides must remain on openai-chat: with no wire-semantic change
The openai-chat: qualifier must be registered as a deprecated compatibility surface with a scheduled removal target of v1.0.0 and emit a once-per-run deprecation notice for hosted openai-chat: usage

Provider resolution logic across config.py, providers.py, model_classes.py, and capabilities.py must be updated to route hosted OpenAI to openai-responses: while preserving endpoint-based fallback to openai-chat:
Contract tests for openai-responses: must pass with pydantic-ai 1.107.2 covering structured output, streaming, tool calls, and retries
Documentation must explain the wire-semantic change, how to explicitly opt into the deprecated openai-chat: fallback, and the v1.0.0 removal horizon
